entities.name: BSCPL Infrastructure Limited- KNR Constructions Limited

operating_notes.text: Received ₹130.10 Cr settlement from NHAI for Madurai-Ramanathapuram and Pollachi-Coimbatore sections of NH 83.
Received ₹32.87 Cr claim settlement (including ₹6.89 Cr interest) from NHAI for Hubli-Hospet section of NH-63.
Completed sale of KNR Palani Infra Private Limited to Indus Infra Trust for ₹205.05 Cr with ₹90 Cr cash upstreamed.
Total order book stands at ₹11,903 Cr as of March 31, 2026, including two new HAM projects worth ₹3,897 Cr.
Achieved financial closure for 80.01 km NH-167 HAM project in Telangana on 01 October 2026.

holders.name: HSBC MUTUAL FUND - HSBC VALUE FUND

timeline.summary: Received ₹130.10 Cr from NHAI as settlement for claims related to two NH 83 highway projects.
Received ₹32.87 Cr (including ₹6.89 Cr interest) from NHAI as settlement for claims on the Hubli-Hospet section of NH-63.
Promoter K Narsimha Reddy declares no pledge or encumbrance on promoter group shares as of April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹695.59 Cr, net profit ₹106.1 Cr (includes ₹12.48 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹93.62 Cr).
2026-05-29: Completed transfer of entire equity share capital in subsidiary KNR Palani Infra Private Limited to Indus Infra Trust for ₹205.05 Cr.
KNR Constructions Limited’s **Haritha Varanasi** uploaded the earnings call recording on June 1, 2026, via the company website.
KNR Constructions hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on June 1, 2026, reporting an order book of ₹11,903 Cr and guiding for 10%-11% EBITDA margins.
CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed KNR Constructions' long-term rating at CRISIL AA/Stable and short-term rating at CRISIL A1+.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹587.94 Cr (-4.0% YoY), net profit ₹80.72 Cr (-34.6% YoY) (includes ₹7.15 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹73.57 Cr).
KNR Constructions Limited informed the exchanges about the revocation of a ₹157.55 Cr Letter of Acceptance from GHMC for a flyover and underpass project in Telangana.
KNR Constructions subsidiary KNR Manyamkonda Infra achieved financial closure for an 80 km NH-167 HAM project in Telangana.
